write_boundary: 项目内配置/快照/单手结果及缓存；目录双手结果写已验证共同子任务根/processed.h5，v21采集HDF5双手结果写同目录<源文件stem>.processed.h5；碰撞后处理仅在输入同目录新建结果；不修改原始采集文件
backend: FastAPI，仅本机8091；JSON错误{detail:中文信息}；显式DGST USB或无相机ADB编码器采集；准备只启动板端已有程序，不刷机、不写板端标定、不调用原网关

numeric_interface.Engine(hand, calibration, *, self_collis: calibration is existing UrdfZeroProfile-compatible dict. self_collision is a strict bool, applied only to this Hand2 solver. Provides exoskeleton_names, wuji_names, keypoint_names, collision_policy (actual JSON self-collision policy), model_paths={exoskeleton: Path, wujihand2: Path} and step(raw_angles_deg) -> dict.
numeric_interface.Engine.set_calibration(calibration): Validate and replace zero/direction/CS mapping at segment boundaries; preserve model and solver history.
numeric_interface.step_result: {exoskeleton: ndarray(21)|None, hand: ndarray(21,3)|None, wujihand2: ndarray(20)|None, errors: {exoskeleton: str, hand: str, wujihand2: str}}; hand uses MediaPipe indices, thumb CMC (1) is reconstructed as midpoint of wrist (0) and thumb MCP (2), other 20 points unchanged; the same hand coordinates are exported, rendered and retargeted. Each stage independently valid, exceptions not silently replaced by previous poses; no rendering or network
numeric_interface.preview(hand, calibration, raw_angles_de: Returns {joint_names:list[str], qpos_rad:list[float]} after zero/direction/mechanism only; incomplete calibration supported for UI by holding uncalibrated joints at zero BEFORE linkage conversion; downstream processing requires full calibration
numeric_interface.create_hand2_retargeter(hand, *, self_co: 加载并校验官方手侧模型和20个关节；None沿用正式配置，self_collision=True仅在内存启用该实例自碰撞；pinch_position_weights按thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky覆盖本次指尖位置倍率，不改alpha混合上限、方向项或全手形状项，不写配置文件
numeric_interface.resources(hand): Returns {exoskeleton: Path, wujihand2: Path}; both paths inside project assets
numeric_interface.profile(hand): Returns V21 mapping/config dict inside project config; includes expected_cs_by_joint

hand2_postprocessing_interface.prepare_collision(path): 完整校验已处理单手/双手HDF5，返回CollisionInput(path, sha256, counts)，不要求原始录制可用
hand2_postprocessing_interface.process_hand2(source, output, progress=N: 仅逐帧重算Hand2，支持先关闭碰撞生成指定位置倍率版本，再以该版本为源、使用同样倍率启用碰撞；时间戳与前两阶段不变，原子非覆盖发布，实际倍率和碰撞策略写入processing_json；HTTP碰撞任务沿用self_collision=True和默认位置倍率

recording_interface.Recording: dataclass fields path:Path, hand:str, device_id:str (canonical lowercase hex without 0x), cs_by_joint:tuple[int,...], timestamps_ns:ndarray int64, angles_deg:ndarray float64 (N,21) ALWAYS RAW ABSOLUTE [0,360), sequence:ndarray|None, drops:ndarray|None, metadata:dict; count property
recording_interface.load_recording(path, metadata=None, *, h: 只读支持明确的HDF5、JSON、USB JSONL、compact CSV及pico格式；v21_glove_capture v1必须以hand选择内部手侧，普通格式hand仅核对身份。metadata只能补缺失事实，禁止覆盖来源或伪造已应用标定。拒绝缺失角度语义、损坏时间戳、非有限/越界角与接线冲突。
recording_interface.load_aligned_pair(path, calibrations, an: v21_aligned_60hz v1文件或唯一文件目录；后两参数必须各含left/right，分别为完整项目标定和raw_absolute_0_360或calibrated_signed_pm180；返回左右Recording，手动事实标记user_supplied，完整源文件SHA256派生共同身份，保留time/unix_ns。拒绝相同设备、串手和recording_correction；source_frame不是sequence。
recording_interface.GROUPS: list of {name,label,channels:[J1,...]}; six anatomical groups from existing V21 grouping
recording_interface.new_calibration(recording): UrdfZeroProfile-compatible dict with offsets null, captured_groups [], directions all +1, device_id, hand, expected_cs_by_joint and capture_cs_by_joint
recording_interface.recording_calibration(recording): v21采集HDF5的已核验板端标定或aligned录制的手动上传参数转为完整内存微调基线，保留真实来源；没有适用基线返回None，不写设备配置或源录制。
recording_interface.capture_group(recording, calibration, gr: frame indices half-open [start,stop); returns NEW updated calibration dict; circular median, existing stability limit 1.5 degrees central80, >=100 frames, timestamp duration>=1.0s (UI selects recommended1.5s); genuine sequence/drop checks when available, otherwise honest timestamp continuity; checks input zero identity/wiring
recording_interface.validate_calibration(calibration, record: raise ValueError for incorrect complete groups/directions/identity/mapping/units; returns None
recording_interface.save_calibration(calibration, directory,: atomic write fixed basename hand_deviceid.json, reject existing unless explicit overwrite, no path traversal; returns Path; verify complete

joint_mapping_interface.cs_by_joint(hand): 左右独立物理CS表，按标准J1..J21返回tuple；禁止按另一侧表推算或覆盖真实录制接线
joint_mapping_interface.source_indices(hand, raw_cs_by_joint): 按该侧物理CS将标准J定位到原始帧列，严格验证完整21路排列
joint_mapping_interface.joint_definitions(): 按J1..J21排列的{channel,joint_name,label}；joint_channels._JOINTS为唯一解剖定义：J1-5侧摆、J6-10掌骨屈伸、J11-15次末节屈伸、J16-20末端屈伸，组内拇指到小拇指，J21小拇指CMC。两侧共享，不从旧右手配置推断，不共享零位、direction、scale或模型
joint_mapping_interface.joint_layout(hand, raw_cs_by_joint): 按标准J排列的[{channel,joint_name,label,cs,source_index}]；source_index为原始21角数组的0起始索引

live_interface.invariants: hand为用户明确选择，device_hand为设备/出厂声明仅作提示；host_session以hand_selection_version=1记录选择并在重载时恢复，普通离线事实冲突仍拒绝；frame为原始绝对角[0,360)，64位整数转十进制字符串；点击后采样，不借用旧帧；单会话事务串行、重连更换session_id；只有正常停止才发布录制。DGST保留原始CS/线上角度/板端标定并依原标定恢复原始角，视频独立排空；兼容模式只读板端ma782-read，raw counts按360/65536换算，不启动相机或DGST，元数据和稳定设备ID明确标记host_generated，board_device_id保留真实SoC serial。优先校验出厂CS/手侧及设备绑定；仅无出厂时采用用户所选配置并标记explicit_hand_profile，损坏/冲突出厂记录拒绝。兼容序号为主机交付计数，原驱动scan_sequence/时间/原始CS计数/传输掩码/overruns保留在每帧source_sample，不宣称物理扫描无丢失。

GET /api/jobs -> {jobs:[Job]}; FIFO单并发，列表不依赖当前打开录制；Job={id,kind:single|pair|wujihand2_collision,self_collision:bool,task_name,source_root,source_path?,created_at,state:queued|running|cancelling|complete|error,done,total,active_hand,queue_position,sides:{left/right:{state,done,total}},snapshots,output_path,path?,error?}；碰撞后处理任务self_collision固定true

GET /api/results/{id}/download -> application/x-hdf5

frontend: 中文原生JS + Three.js + Vite，本地依赖无CDN。顶部七模块标签每次仅显示一页，切换保留状态；导入、结果打开、任务提交自动定位对应模块。微调显示实际五阶段准备进度，所有可用视频解码、URDF模型及公共起点对齐后开放编辑；失败保持锁定并允许重试。播放中媒体缓冲或模型落后冻结公共时钟，恢复后继续。仅显示双glove与头部RGB_left/RGB_right四路，按源宽高比排列，不请求IR，不改变原时间偏移。移除本侧快照选择/重载界面，内部快照仍冻结导出。结果页联合文件同时显示左右各三阶段及本侧dataglove视频，单手只显示实际手侧；公共相对秒轴按各侧真实时间戳选帧，暂停/倍速/拖动/前后联动，越界或无效隐藏，旧请求不覆盖新定位。只读结果，不重新求解或连接原网关。
hdf5: 单手schema=glove_v21_processed，联合schema=glove_v21_pair_processed，均schema_version=1。联合根含recording_uuid/complete，left/right组各含原单手结构：timestamp_ns、exoskeleton/{joint_names,qpos_rad,valid,error}、hand/{keypoint_names,keypoints_m,valid,error}、wujihand2/{joint_names,qpos_rad,valid,error}、metadata/{calibration_json,recording_json,processing_json}。两手长度独立，NaN/valid=false保留失败帧；hand是固定参数21点骨架，不是MANO pose/betas。普通联合导出仅在两侧完整成功后原子发布或替换同UUID结果。碰撞后处理原子非覆盖发布新文件，保留时间戳、上游dataset和原追溯，只更新wujihand2及对应valid_counts/processing_json；processing_json.wujihand2_postprocess记录源路径/SHA256、实际配置、当前实现/资产指纹，wujihand2_self_collision记录已启用策略；无效上游、非有限输入或求解失败保留帧并标记Hand2无效。
